changes: New selected chat moments retain at most two preceding user excerpts within fifteen minutes, with source IDs and timestamps. Only already-offered material is eligible.
Recall scores the primary event and each contextual quote independently; a small writing-topic alias group supplements existing chess aliases.
Deleting a contextual source removes its cue without removing an independently sourced main moment. Store commit checks deleted cue sources as well as the epoch.
Ordinary user turns no longer receive unrelated recent-diary fallback; empty-topic proactive consideration retains that option.
Diary generation and recall slots distinguish present retrospective attitudes from historical details and user experiences from the character's own history.
Explicit memory questions conditionally ask the model to verify matching evidence and admit uncertainty if no matching material is available.
scope_limits: No extra model calls, memory service, vector database or classifier added.
Frozen personas, persona assets and current mood behavior were not changed.
Existing pages remain readable and are not automatically backfilled with context.
Prompt constraints do not prove semantic grounding of generated prose.

regression.host_core_before_last_prompt_and_gate_ch: passed, including 53 diary assertions and the unchanged 84-scenario native memory replay

framework_broad.note: Affected suites before final wording and unrelated-diary gate; excludes unrelated model setup/update suites and the already-validated Python HTTP replay.

intermediate_infrastructure_issues: The opt-in live harness needed a checked JSONException-compatible throws declaration to compile against Android JSON; test harness only.
A build overlapped Robolectric's open APK resource handle; serialization of builds resolved the file lock and overlapping instrumentation compilation. Final checks used the completed final build.
One earlier notebook instrumentation run failed while UiAutomation was connecting/disconnecting. An unchanged rerun and the final-build run passed; product UI did not change.

live_model.method: Same synthetic scenarios and product transport/prompt/parser/storage harness as baseline. Independent probes isolate the diary channel; no real user's history sent.

final_diagnostics_recheck.note: Reran the complete diagnostic conversations after DNS recovered, with the same product and model settings. Initial failures are retained separately.

unrelated_recent_diary_injection.note: Independent dinner probes plus diagnostic conversation topic switches.

game_diary_historical_detail.note: Strict review: one final diary still described an unrecorded feeling at the past event rather than only a present attitude.

final_game_chat_grounding.note: Still fails strict grounding: e.g. invented intentional loss, past internal state or later private review. No claim that hallucination was solved.

remaining_issues: Game replies still invent past mental states, causes or later review even though structured event facts remain correct; withholding recollection does not fully prevent this.
A diagnostic paraphrase answer drifted on numbers. Diary topic selection is not equivalent to faithful generation.
Some replies use meta-memory wording, arbitrary statements or reminders not explicitly requested; conversational naturalness remains variable.
Some topic-switch replies answer dinner but still mention the writing task from recent conversation history. Removing unrelated diary fallback does not erase recent chat context.
One final primary request returned malformed/incomplete output and was rejected by the existing parser.
live_model.interpretation: Source-backed recall and no-memory honesty improved in this small sample. Stored reflections improved but conversational factual grounding is still unresolved. These are assistant-reviewed qualitative observations, not independent human ratings or population success rates.
